channel.title: Net Sense
channel.description: Studio network monitoring for Mac, by Nathaniel Labs.

item.description:
# Net Sense 1.1.0
Team access release for the native Mac app.
- Enrols a team phone, iPad or Mac by scanning a five-minute, single-use QR shown under Settings → Team devices. - Opens automatically on enrolled devices with no shared password: browser devices retain their token locally and the native Mac app uses Keychain. - Adds Viewer and Operator roles. Viewers can see every page; Operators can reconnect or block clients, restart access points, change channels and run speed tests. - Keeps destructive rogue scans, controller credentials, alert settings, Wi-Fi credentials and device revocation hub-only. - Stores only SHA-256 token hashes on the hub, expires devices after 90 unused days, and revokes access on the very next request. - Adds route-level security tests for every read and protected mutation, including one-use codes, query-string rejection and raw-token persistence checks. - Makes team access available over the studio LAN while denying every private endpoint to devices without an enrolled token. - Signed with Jason's Developer ID and accepted and stapled by Apple's notarization service.
